bio_zh:
（範例簡介，請在後台替換）
生於台灣，現居台北。以油彩與水彩描繪海岸、室內與城市的光線，關注日常場景中稍縱即逝的時刻。
bio_en:
(Sample bio — replace it in the editor.)
Born in Taiwan and based in Taipei, working in oil and watercolour on the light of coastlines, interiors and the city at night.
